author: (Megerle von Mühlfeld, 1824)

note.en: A small turban-like snail of Caribbean rubble. The only local record is from 15 m northeast of Almendros y Corales (1998), so it is only a record.
note.es: Un caracol pequeño tipo turbante de escombro del Caribe. El único registro local es de 15 m al noreste de Almendros y Corales (1998), así que es solo un registro.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Survey record NE of Almendros y Corales (1998), a Gandoca-Manzanillo sector site; only one record.
